title: Wireframe latitude/longitude globe (Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine) that procedurally generates: Build a sphere represented only as a wireframe of latitude and longitude rings -- each ring modeled as a thin torus (a tube swept around a circle) rather than as flat line-primitives, so the result is a real solid mesh. Sphere radius, number of latitude rings, number of longitude rings, and tube thickness must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
